CUSTOM FURNITURE

How a custom order comes together

Most WixWood furniture is made to order. Here's the process from first message to delivery.

01

Tell us what you need

Share the piece you're imagining — a table, chair set, signage, or a full interior fit-out.

02

Share dimensions & inspiration

Send measurements, reference photos, or sketches of the space it's going into.

03

Discuss materials & design

Agree on wood type, finish, and design details with the WixWood team.

04

Receive a quote

A price based on materials, size, and complexity — no guessing.

05

Production begins

Your piece is shaped, joined and finished by hand in the workshop.

06

Delivery

The finished piece is delivered to your location.

Request a Custom Quote

Opens WhatsApp with your details pre-filled — nothing is sent until you tap send there.

CRAFTSMANSHIP & MATERIALS

Every piece is shaped by hand

From raw hardwood to a finished piece, each step happens in the WixWood workshop — no assembly-line shortcuts.

  • Solid hardwood construction, joined and shaped by hand
  • Hand sanding and sealing for a smooth, durable finish
  • Poured epoxy/resin detailing on select tables
  • Torch and heat-textured wood finishes
  • Hand-carved lettering for signage and nameplates

ABOUT WIXWOOD

A Nigerian woodworking studio

WixWood Crafts is a Nigerian woodworking studio building furniture and wood pieces by hand — from statement dining tables to everyday bowls, cups, and signage. Pieces are designed, carved and finished in the workshop, built to order rather than mass produced.

Follow the day-to-day work of the workshop on Instagram @wizwood_.
